distractors.reason: 'Make therapy' is not used. 'Make' creates things; a person undergoes treatment.
'Do therapy' is not standard. 'Do' pairs with tasks.
'Take therapy' is possible in informal speech but less precise. 'Undergo' suggests a formal course of treatment.

example_sentence: Many patients ___ therapy after the trauma.
l1_interference: Русскоговорящие могут сказать 'make therapy' по аналогии с 'проходить'; в английском клиническом языке используют 'undergo therapy'.
explanation: 'Undergo therapy' means to go through a treatment, often a formal course. It is standard in clinical and psychological writing.
memory_tip: UNDERGO THERAPY = go through a formal treatment | MAKE / DO are not used
